exampleSection.title: Phased training complex development
exampleSection.body: A regional training center started with a core module set for basic live-fire and forcible entry training. Phase two added multi-level modules and burn rooms for high-rise and fireground disciplines. Phase three integrated hazmat and tactical prop interfaces into a comprehensive emergency training complex — all without demolition, with investment that continuously appreciates.
